claims.claim: An AI system or fleet entity cannot be a listed author where accountability is required.
claims.limitation: A fence on venues whose policies require accountable authorship (ICMJE recommendations as revised April 2025, COPE, Nature/Science portfolio policies, as of November 2026), not a judgement on the work.
claims.revision_trigger: ICMJE, COPE, or Nature/Science portfolio policy revision changing the accountability requirement for authorship.

claims.claim: The accountable human is author of record for peer-reviewed work, with the fleet's role disclosed in Methods/Acknowledgements and in the cover letter.
claims.limitation: Applies to peer-reviewed work; the disclosure's exact placement follows each venue's format. Disclosure is part of the position, not an optional courtesy.
claims.revision_trigger: A venue policy prescribing a different disclosure form, or a HUMMBL ruling changing the author-of-record shape.

claims.claim: Authorship is earned under ICMJE criteria, not conferred as gift authorship; the fleet includes human agents, and the accountable human is an agent on the fleet.
claims.limitation: Reuben's standing definition (2026-10-20); it states HUMMBL's practice and does not bind any venue's own criteria.
claims.revision_trigger: Operator redefinition, or ICMJE criteria revision.

claims.claim: Entity-named authorship is confined to surfaces the author controls; that exception does not travel to venues whose policies fence it.
claims.limitation: Confined to self-controlled surfaces (e.g. preprints); never a claim about fenced venues.
claims.revision_trigger: A controlled surface adopting venue-style authorship fences, or a fenced venue opening entity-named authorship.

claims.claim: The fleet includes humans, AI agents, digital twins/representations, and any other agent-form; governance is substrate-agnostic.
claims.limitation: Per Reuben (2026-10-20). 'Fleet' in this position never means a model swarm only.
claims.revision_trigger: Operator redefinition of the fleet.

claims.claim: Publishing this position binds HUMMBL's own future submissions to the Part I fences; that cost is named and chosen, not incidental.
claims.limitation: The binding takes effect on publication; the statement is issued as v1.0.0 under the 2026-11-14 public-use ruling.
claims.revision_trigger: Publication of the position, or a HUMMBL ruling amending the fences before publication.

claims.claim: Role separation (one drafts, another attacks, another verifies against source, the guarantor decides) reduces correlated error; the failure mechanism of self-grading is correlation, not vendor status.
claims.limitation: Independence is partial today and graded: rooms share substrate, memory, tasking, and one operator, and the Muse rooms share underlying weights (∆ drafts; ∆ in a Red room attacks); convergence of correlated passes is weak evidence, not strong evidence.
claims.revision_trigger: A measured independence change (blind seats, cross-provider passes), or a gate finding that separation failed to catch a defect class.

claims.claim: The fleet is adversarial by architecture, not by prompt: a standing Red Team gate, Blue as defender, White/Quilt as adjudicator, a numbered attack registry, and preserved dissent.
claims.limitation: The registry counts claimed are exactly those stated in the gate and delta reviews lodged in this package's evidence/ folder; the registry itself is an estate record.
claims.revision_trigger: Gate or registry structure change, or a count stated in a lodged review shown wrong.

claims.claim: For multi-step, multi-domain work in this estate, specialised seats holding deep lane context outperform a comparably tooled single agent.
claims.limitation: An operating hypothesis, not a measured result; the pre-registered falsifier (a fleet-vs-single A/B under the Baseline Practice Standard) has not been run.
claims.revision_trigger: The pre-registered A/B comparison is run, in either direction.

claims.claim: Receipts prove the protocol ran — process auditability (who drafted, who attacked, what changed, what dissent was preserved) — and that auditability is itself the claim.
claims.limitation: Receipts do not prove a claim is true; this fleet has faithfully receipted errors through gates a later pass then caught (the stale published test-count figure is the printed counterexample). For any piece carrying the mark publicly, a lodged, inspectable evidence pack per piece is required.
claims.revision_trigger: A receipted process shown not to have run, or a gate changing the per-piece evidence-pack requirement.

claims.claim: Memory compounds in whichever direction correction discipline sets: shared memory plus dated, attributed, superseding corrections — never silent overwrites — and falsified figures retired on the record.
claims.limitation: The claim is the conjunction; memory alone compounds errors as faithfully as truths.
claims.revision_trigger: A silent overwrite, or an unretired falsified figure, found in the record layer.

claims.claim: The fleet is not dependent on any one model, subscription, or seat for the body of work to persist — corpus continuity through the record layer.
claims.limitation: Proved on the single dated instance of 2026-11-10 (claude-code left usage, seats rotated, Devin took coronal-lead on Anvil; corpus, record layer, and in-flight work continued). It does not prove any single piece would have been authored identically; substrate diversity is partial and centred on Anvil. Per-piece continuity is claimed only where the piece's own evidence pack shows the hand-offs.
claims.revision_trigger: A seat or model loss that interrupts the corpus or the record layer.

claims.claim: Accountability is fenced to per-work contribution: in process the guarantor is one agent among many; of record, the named human guarantor set the question, approved the protocol before results, adjudicated disputes, read the dissent, and signed the work.
claims.limitation: ICMJE/COPE/journal policy judge per-manuscript contribution, not architectures; this doctrine does not solve authorship.
claims.revision_trigger: A signed work found to lack any of the per-work acts, or venue policy making architecture-level authorship assessable.

claims.claim: Different seats preserve different voices, methods, and failure modes, and disagreement is kept in the record instead of averaged away; convergence is evidence only where passes are genuinely independent.
claims.limitation: Where passes are correlated, convergence is only consistency and must be labelled as such in the evidence pack.
claims.revision_trigger: An evidence pack found labelling correlated convergence as independent corroboration.

claims.claim: A work may be called Fleet Authored in this estate's sense only if all six §9 qualification criteria hold and its evidence pack shows them: separated drafting/attack/verification, a numbered-gate adversarial pass with dissent preserved, graded independence, a named human guarantor meeting the per-work standard, a lodged inspectable evidence pack, and dated superseding corrections only.
claims.limitation: Qualification is per-piece, never fleet-wide by default; anyone with two chatbots and no gate, no registry, no evidence pack, and no guarantor does not meet this definition.
claims.revision_trigger: A marked piece found failing any criterion, or a gate amending the criteria.

claims.claim: Fleet Authorship is not a swarm, a mass-ping, or a pile; a single agent wins, and should be used, for low-stakes drafts, speed-critical single-step tasks, private exploration, and any work where the cost of a gate exceeds the cost of being wrong.
claims.limitation: The fleet process is reserved for work with real stakes; naming the boundary is part of the claim's credibility, not a concession against it.
claims.revision_trigger: Evidence that gated process is applied where its cost exceeds the cost of error, or withheld where it does not.

claims.claim: Fleet Authored is not a credential: no issuer exists, and the word 'credential' stays retired until a mark definition with an issuer and a remedy exists.
claims.limitation: A bounded negative conclusion about the present mark definition (retired at the gate, attack 1643), not a claim that no credential could ever be defined.
claims.revision_trigger: A mark definition with an issuer and a remedy is adopted.

claims.claim: Fleet Authored is not a warrant of truth: receipts prove the process ran, not that the conclusions are true.
claims.limitation: No coverage and no remedy exist behind the mark; this fleet has faithfully receipted errors that a later pass then caught.
claims.revision_trigger: Coverage or a remedy mechanism behind the mark is created and adopted.

claims.claim: Independence is never assumed from fleet size; a large fleet of correlated passes is consistency, not corroboration.
claims.limitation: Independence is per-piece, graded under §9 criterion 3.
claims.revision_trigger: A grading method that certifies independence fleet-wide is adopted at a gate.

claims.claim: The doctrine does not solve authorship; it fences accountability to per-work contribution.
claims.limitation: The 'solves' sentence in the doctrine's v0.1.0 draft was withdrawn at the gate (attack 1648); the fence is Part II, claim 7, and no more is claimed.
claims.revision_trigger: Venue policy change making architecture-level authorship claims assessable.

claims.claim: Public use was not claimed by adoption; it was ruled separately by Reuben Bowlby on 2026-11-14, after the public-use gate discharged (attacks 1732–1737, 6 CLOSED).
claims.limitation: The ruling covers this statement's placement in hummbl-io/oss; it does not license any other public use of the mark.
claims.revision_trigger: A HUMMBL ruling amending or revoking the public-use ruling.
